name: Benstore Versions
subtitle: Every Benstore build, for downgrading
description: Install any past Benstore build. It installs over Benstore like an update; use Update in Settings to go back to the newest.

apps.subtitle: Latest · build 56
apps.localizedDescription: Auto-strip: if an app won't install because of something inside it (a broken extension, Watch app, App Clip, junk files, device-only limits), Benstore strips the parts it's choking on and retries automatically. Frameworks the app needs and your tweaks are never removed. Each step shows in the log.
